name: seis-canonical-registry-validator
description: Read-only validation of SEIS registry records, owners, statuses, and duplicate IDs.

interface.shortDescription: Check registry identity and ownership locally.
interface.longDescription: A deterministic, local-only SEIS governance plugin that inspects JSON registry projections for stable IDs, statuses, owners, duplicate records, and source-of-truth hints without editing registry files.
defaultPrompt: Find duplicate registry IDs and owner gaps.
Report registry evidence without editing files.
